title: The Enchanter's Ledger
about: Enchanting without magic. Design intricate magical diagrams for paying customers, research new runes, and build your workshop’s reputation one commission at a time.

controls.desc: Draw diagrams; click a guide rune, then click the slate to place a tracing guide
Hold on the slate to erase ink; right-click a selected guide rune to deselect
Test the diagram / deliver the product
Research new runes / decline the current commission
